headline: Military dog startup Warhound emerges with $200 million
summary: Warhound emerged from stealth with $200 million in funding to genetically engineer working dogs for military and law enforcement use, equipped with body armor, though outlets differ on who founded the company.

claims.statement: Warhound emerged from stealth with $200 million in funding to genetically engineer working dogs.

sources.quote: Warhound came out of stealth on Wednesday with $200 million in funding
Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs

claims.statement: The dogs are intended for military and law enforcement use, equipped with body armor.
